nom: The Ordinary Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2% Serum with Pure L-Ascorbic Acid

avis.texte: I say this works, been using for a month and see a difference in skintone.

This product definitely isn't my favorite texture, and the first time I tried it I used way too much and it stung. But I found that using a small amount pretty much eliminates the sting and the grittiness goes away pretty quickly. For the price, it's been phenomenal lightening acne scars and dark spots. I'll definitely buy it again.
It made my skin extremely red in seconds. I would not use this. My skin is normally not super sensitive, but I had to put ice on my face afterwards.

Super grainy and absolutely hate the texture of this product. Plus it stings, almost burns when applied to skin, that alone makes me nervous so I have discontinued the use. I love the Ordinary line but this one missed the mark.

Applied a couple of times with same burning skin result. Not sure if the burning is due to the formulation or the serum's texture - think gritty side of an emery board. Either way, didn't work for me. Tossed in the trash.

avis.titre: Horrific texture, does not absorb not worth the savings
avis.texte: I am a firm believer in the power of Vitamin C serums they can truly transform your skin. However, I've found that many of them can be quite expensive. I decided to try this product as a more affordable option, but it was a lesson learned you really do get what you pay for when it comes to skincare. The formulation of this serum is among the worst I've encountered. It's greasy and runny, and it does not absorb well into the skin. The texture of the "suspension" HA spheres feels like rubbing rocks on your face. I'm no stranger to exfoliating treatments, but I certainly don't want that rugged feeling in a serum meant for daily use. While it may not be a significant financial loss, the effects on my skin have been far from pleasant. The Ordinary really needs to revisit their testing methods for this one. Awful

avis.titre: I have been using for a while now and it works
avis.texte: I wish the tube was bigger.The price is right. I will buy again

avis.titre: I would recommend trying this vitamin C product
avis.texte: If you're not used to using vitamin C, I would definitely recommend trying the ordinary, vitamin C suspension. It does give you a little bit of a tingly effect, but I have noticed my skin is more vibrant and firmer.

The serum is recommended to be used at night, which is good because its like spreading sand on your face. On my skin, it stinks like self tanning lotion, yuck! Ill use it at night, but will be looking for a different product.

This product is incredible! I've seen several people talking about the smell, claiming it stings! Yes, the scent is strong, but Vitamin C is meant to be used in the morning, not at night... (or rather, yes, you *can* use it at night due to its composition), but the smell isn't unbearable! People whose skin is already damaged or prone to acne shouldn't be using this product! Instead, you should go see a dermatologist don't blame the product! Another thing: drinking water is essential!!!!!! This product isn't going to work miracles if you only drink one glass of water a day and spend the rest of the time downing soda.
I couldn't get past the terrible gritty texture. I used it for a couple weeks and didn't notice a difference. I couldn't bear to keep at it longer cause of the texture.

While this is a great effective product, I would use it with great care and caution-especially if you have sensitive skin. I wait at least a half an hour after washing my face before applying it. And never use this right after exfoliating with a washcloth or cleansing brush-because it will make your skin turn red and sting like crazy.. Also, be careful how much you use. If you use too much the product will pill by the time you get to your moisturizer. But if I put a drop of facial oil into my moisturizer that helps with the pilling. On the plus side, this cream really does a great job of breaking down my dark spots and making my complexion more even!

I have a few darker spots on my cheeks and after 3 weeks, saw a noticeable difference in those areas. I spot treat at night and while there's a texture to the cream & a tingling sensation, none of that bothers me to stop using. For years I've been investing in Sunday Riley Vitamin C and I never saw the results like the one this cream is giving me.

avis.titre: I didn't see very much results
avis.texte: I used to cover for my face and neck, unfortunately, the greediness wasn't attractive. I felt the stinging on every part of my face that the solution reached, usually I feel a little tenderness around the eyes, but my cheeks, forehead, chin and nose were tingling. And why didn't someone tell me about the smell, I kept checking the expiration date to see if this package was expired!
I don't like the gritty feeling of it and it doesn't offer mostiure

This Vitamin C suspension has a gritty texture, which is this customer first time trying this type of Vitamin C. It caused a slight tingling/burning sensation, then redness. This product was returned and a Vitamin C serum purchased. No problems with the serum.

avis.titre: Why everyone not talking abt the size
avis.texte: I bought this product and it clearly says it's 30ml, but when I opened it, it felt almost empty—maybe only 5ml inside! I can't believe a company would sell something like this and mislead customers. Are you guys serious? This feels like a total scam. Don't waste your money on this seller, and think twice before buying anything online from them. I'm really disappointed and frustrated.
The texture was startling at first but i quickly got used to it. I only use this product at night, but when i wake up my skin looks so hydrated and youthful
I agree with some of the other reviews. It has a bad smell. It feels gritty. It's also oily looking on my skin.

The texture of this moisturizer is very off and it has that gritty texture so when you use it im not sure if its dead skin or the product is pilling either way from the other reviews im pretty sure that is the vitamin C in action. Aside from that this is an amazing product, ive been using it for about a week and so far it has really helped my skin, it looks brighter and gives my face a nice dewy finish that lasts all day without the oily feel that often comes with. I had been struggling with that as I have dry skin and I was having a hard time finding a balance between too much moisture and too little. The only thing I dont love about this product is the texture which is worth it to me considering the results. If you have sensitive skin I'd recommend not using it everyday as it has exfoliating components. I feel some tingling when using this product sometimes so if your skin is sensitive Id say used it 2-3 times a week.
Awful texture, burning sensation…left it on for 5 minutes and had to wash it off. Threw it away immediately. Cerave vitamin C is much better.
I miss the 23% Vitamin C WITHOUT HA. It was so amazing. HA is so overrated, please stop putting it in everything.
If you want to feel like your putting sand on your face have at it! Couldn't stand the texture.

I have a huge dark spot on my forehead from a terrible cellulitis infection i had 6 months ago. Started using this to brighten the spot and its working just after a week. Im so happy. Yes its gritty, yes it can be oily and thats why i only use it in my nighttime routine. I will continue this.

I just bought this to try out. I was using Paula's Choice vitamin serum booster, however, wanted to find something i can use for an inexpensive price. The Ordinary products are always good. So far i like this product!
Appreciate the high strength for a low price, more effective than much more expensive options.

avis.titre: This is my favorite Vitamin C serum.
avis.texte: I don't agree with the comments suggesting this texture is bad. I appreciate the texture and understand that the slight texture is what holds the Vitamin C in the serum so it can be used by the skin without breaking down first in the bottle. That's why this serum feels different and that's why it actually works, unlike many Vitamin C serums where the Vitamin C is degraded long before it comes in contact with your skin.

It feels like a microdermabrasion scrub on your face and it instantly caused me to have an intense burning sensation. I wiped it right back off with a cold towel & will not try it again. I do have sensitive skin but I use a lot of other products with no issues.

I never write reviews but had to on this one- I purchased this Vit C product because it was slightly less expensive than my usual one, but oh my god I should have read reviews before buying. It STINKS. So smelly. Will be returning because it's so bad. Also be careful using it with other products, I didn't think about it beforehand so that's on me, but I used an acne product with it and it left red marks exactly where I put it (when I usually have no problems layering it with a vit C product)
So far this has been really great. Goes on smooth, absorbs quickly. Feel a little tingle, but not excessive. My skin seems smoother.
lo compre pero no lo use hasta un mes después, y cuando lo hice la crema no servía olía horrible a rancio.
This may be the stinkiest skincare product I've ever bought in my life. Absolutely no reason for its putrid, disgusting stank.

This product does wonders for my face. BUT as soon as I started using it I noticed that my hands would smell like metal for DAYS afterwards. Doesn't matter how much I wash them, the smell won't go away. So only use this if you aren't sensitive to strong smells.
Burnt my face bad, tried about 4 times and had to get rid of it because it was unbearable.

I've used this serum for six months now and it's brightened my dark spots significantly. You will feel a stinging tingle when you put the serum on. That's because of the high concentration of Vitamin C. You will become adjusted to it if you keep using it. You'll begin to see results after a few weeks of use. I only wish the Ordinary made a serum with an even higher concentration of Vitamin C. This is one of my favorite products from the Ordinary.

avis.titre: I can get past the grittiness but not the smell
avis.texte: Nothing could prepare me for the smell. That has no bearing on effectiveness but it's a dealbreaker for me. Wish I could tolerate the smell enough to use it and see results but I just cannot 🤮

i have psoriasis on my forehead and behind my ears and for the last year ive been using vitamin c serum on it and it improved the look and feel of it a lot, so i thought that i would try this one bc its a lotion which i thought would be nice. i usually wash my psoriasis with face wash in the shower and then apply vitamin c, then derma-e face cream over it, so i tried the same and it stung soooo bad! It hurt so much.. althoughhhh it made my psoriasis look so good and blend right into my skin. so i have kind of like a love hate relationship with this product.

avis.titre: I've used this for years and love it
avis.texte: Part of my daily routine and wouldn't be without it. Don't let the reviews or the lower star rating concern you. I have a very regimented facial routine and this is a significant part of it!

This is the real deal. It is gritty, but I have made my own vitamin c serum before in the past, and that was gritty too. Despite the grit, it's very easily blended on the face. It does sting a little, but it delivers results. If you have sensitive skin, or have never used stronger facial products like retinols and glycolic acids, use only a tiny amount mixed with plenty of moisturizer. Don't use on the days you exfoliate or use glycolic anything. Start with a day or two a week and go from there. This is the best I've used, and the price is amazing.

This product is amazing. Yes it's gritty but it works. I'm a Black woman with lots of dark spots and struggle to manage them. This definitely helps lighten. My skin always looks much brighter in the morning after applying at night.

avis.titre: Don't let bad reviews influence your purchase.
avis.texte: I bought this on a whim… despite the bad reviews…and I am so glad that I did. It's gritty and it burns a little when you first put it on… but if you give it enough time to absorbe…and you don't use to much… you will be surprised how well it works. I noticed brighter skin in a couple of days.

Glad that I decided to try this product despite with people were saying about it being greedy and burning their face. This is a very concentrated form of vitamin C. That's why it feels greedy that you just have to let it soak into your face. You also don't want to use too much. Noticed a reduction in the redness on my face so I'm glad that I decided to give it a try. Always like the ordinary products as they are cheap, but they are also high-quality products.
I did not like this os was very oily and did not absorb into my skin. Major miss!
I did not like this os was very oily and did not absorb into my skin. Major miss!
Wanted to try this, but it burned my skin immediately on application. Washed it off right away.

I bought this on a whim about three years ago and it was the best addition to my skin care routine, I can always see an immediate difference in my skin overnight! This is my trusty glow up product, I only use it once a week or once every two weeks so this bottle can last me a long time. I fully recommend to anyone who doesn't only want to use retinol.

I do not classify myself as having sensitive skin, it's rare that anything I use causes the reaction I had after using this. I'm a licensed esthetician in multiple states in the US and have recommend this brand to so many people. but this product is AWFUL. The smell alone made me dislike it at first. Then the sand like texture. If that wasn't enough, once I applied it, my face almost instantly turned red and started to burn. Unfortunately, I also applied it to my neck and I'm pretty sure I'll have a chemical burn there in the morning. I read what to avoid when using this and therefore only applied it to a clean, dry face. I only had it on for a few minutes before I had to wash it off and

I was so excited to try this product as I needed a new vitamin C serum, but didn't want to break the bank! This only was not gritty, but made my ENTIRE face peel off. Did not mix well with my moisturizer on my face. It balled my skin off immediately. This is super disappointing.

I was so excited to try this product as I needed a new vitamin C serum, but didn't want to break the bank! This only was not gritty, but made my ENTIRE face peel off. Did not mix well with my moisturizer on my face. It balled my skin off immediately. This is super disappointing.

Yes, the product is a little gritty, but I feel when I use this and the my night serum, it just soaks into my skin so beautifully. When I wake in the morning, my skin is so well moisturized and looks amazing. I would recommend using with something else ontop. This product is a staple for me.

This had a horribly gritty texture and a very offputting smell that i have never experienced with a vitamin c before. It left my skin feeling very greasy and would often times peel off if i touched my face. Certainly not a fan and i couldn't even force myself to finish the product

avis.titre: Avoid this product. Gritty and burns the skin
avis.texte: I have been so happy with so many of The Ordinary products. This one is definitely a zero star. It goes on gritty and burns my skin. I attempted to keep giving it numerous attempts and finally had to toss it. I wish The Ordinary would format a vitamin c serum aimilar to the other fabulous serums in their product line.

I absolutely hate this product. I used it after other ordinary products and it rubs gritty. So i used it first on my freah face and the burn was awful! It still went on a little gritty. When i put other ordinary products after it the burn was worse and i couldnt wash it off. Do not get this product!

avis.titre: It works! Use at night! Affordable!
avis.texte: I put this one right before bed after washing my face. It is gritty, it doesnt feel great. This would be terrible under make up….But when I wake up my face is so soft and glowing! The gritt goes away quickly after its absorbed into your face. I like that its not in an annoying glass vile that makes a mess every where. The application is easy and its EXTREMELY AFFORDABLE VITAMIN C. I hope they don't get rid of it. Im hooked.
I think the product works well IF you can get past the awful texture. It feels like you're rubbing sand on your hands and face. It doesn't fully absorb into the skin and will leave a slight film

Most times I use it in the morning with mandatory sunscreen over it. But i find using it daily is too harsh for my skin, so 1-2 times a week is plenty. Yes its gritty but it doesnt bother me. I see a huge difference in skin texture when I stop using it…

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this product again
avis.texte: I'm slowly starting to see a difference in the appearance in the skin on my face. The dark spots are slowly going away and my face is starting to look clearer.

I've been using this product for about 3 months now. There is a trick to using it. It is VERY strong and WILL burn if you have sensitive skin and open acne flares. you do NOT want to put this where your glasses rest on your nose because it WILL burn your skin. The texture is gritty and works at exfoliating your skin. I would recommend just a simple cleanse before applying and then a moisturizer after. nothing else. it's not an every day product if you have other night time routines. you definitely don't want to do your makeup over this. If you do a mid-day routine you could do a stand alone treatment. Does this product work? absolutely. it will brighten your skin and leave it soft to the touch. since it's a bit abrasive, I'd suggest doing a gentle exfoliating treatment after to remove the dead skin that will come off after you've used it. It's also going to burn your skin off if you try to lay anything over it, whether it's your glasses or makeup. this product doesn't play well with anything else. If you can find a balance in your routine to use it then you'll be happy with the results. It has significantly reduced my dark spots and evened out the texture of my skin. It looks brighter and feels oh so soft.

avis.titre: Texture and smell is too much
avis.texte: First if all, it legit smells like diarrhea. I generally like doing vit C in the morning and retinol at night but this is not to be worn under makeup. It made my skin so oily which is fine while im sleeping since i have dry skin anyways. I don't like the gritty texture and am afraid of micro tears in my skin it's so gritty. Seriously not sure what they were thinking when they discontinued other vit C products and gave us this instead.
This burn on skin for like 10 min and it hurts so bad i dont even know if i can see results.
Another ulta customer recommended adding a vitamin c supplement to my regime. She was right, my skin seems vibrant. Thank you.

This is a stable form vitamin of C. It's grainy because of the C crystals. It will absorb eventually. I am so happy to have found this! I hope it doesn't get discontinued, it's a great buy if you need C for repair.
This product is not ment to be worn under make up . It takes very liitle product and if used at night you will he good .

This is the only vitamin C product that has worked for me and I absolutely love it. The texture is a little gritty but I only use it at bedtime. Also, I wait a while before layering the next product/serum so there's not a problem with them clumping together. For those who prefer a smoother texture, the Ordinary makes Vitamin C Suspension 30% in Silicone. I tried that one as well but I prefer this one with HA Sphere 2%. The Ordinary is the best. I use several of their products, they are very affordable.

I didn't mind the grittiness but the smell was horrible, I don't like putting anything that smells gross on my face. I didn't read any other reviews about the smell so maybe I just got a defective product? regardless, had to stop using and threw it away.

Absolutely love this serum! It is a gritty texture and takes some time for your skin to get used to. My skin texture was great in a few weeks! 10/10 recommend using it at night though. The texture is not compatible to be applied under makeup

This isnt a luxurious lotion to wear under make up- i have dark spots and textured skin- i will use this at night and wake up with smoother more refreshed skin almost like the gritty texture helps remove dead skin. Its a process I have been using for months and continue to purchase 🥹

Ordinary products are great. It works. Noone believes my age. I also use pycnogenol and Noone in the store seems to know what it is. Love it along with argeline niacinamide 10 . Plus others. Works for me no lines or wrinkles at 73.

I have and use this product as an intensive treatment for pigmentation/dark splotches. IT IS NOT A DAYTIME UPKEEP VITAMIN C TO USE UNDER MAKEUP. It GETS RESULTS and I highly recommend it. I don't want this product to disappear because of unclear instructions. I use this 2x a month to keep the melasma away from my face and body. Yes it's grainy, that's the encapsulated vitamin C which keeps it from degrading! Yes it will sting like crazy, start off by diluting it a bit with a waterbased product and work up. Use it as a nighttime intensive and watch your dark spots disappear.

I had read previous reviews about this product and decided to try it for myself. Directions suggest using it at night, because it has a very sandy texture. I see this as a good thing, because it seems to smooth out the rough spots. Each morning my skin looks better and more glowing. I've been using it for a little more than a week. The only negative to the product is its smell, which is awful, perhaps because the company doesn't use fragrance, which could irritate the skin. Other than that I would buy it again, since it's very affordable.

avis.titre: Need to have a solid routine if planning on using
avis.texte: I had to figure out to make it work, it's very finicky but also very effective, so it is worth it. I use in the am after I mist my face with a rose hydrosol. It goes on better on slight damp skin before other products. After the Vit C, I use The Ordinary moisturizer followed by CC cream with spf 30. Sometimes I add a caffeine based eye serum if I need it. Evening is cleansing, followed by niacinamide and retinol. And followed up with moisturizer right before i get into bed. My skin looks bright and smooth at 44. The price is right for The Ordinary products.
The lotion was gritty and had a smell that was not pleasant. I am returning it.

avis.titre: Do not be mislead by the abrasiveness.
avis.texte: This is a great product! The little crystals are vitamin c, along with HA. You rub it in lightly, soon it dissipates.Using this has dramatically improved my facial skin.
Smells horrible and felt like sandpaper on my skin. Not recommend it.

avis.titre: Good vitamin C serum to use everyday
avis.texte: Thanks to The Ordinary for making this vitamin C serum accessible to everybody. I'm using it overnight and I like my skin the next morning
The product seems to work with my sensitive skin. It was like to container was less than half full. Very odd

I really wish I could love this product because I do feel like it has positive results. I have dry-ish skin, so the "greasy" feeling everyone describes, is more of a dewy and moisturizing feeling for me. The negatives of course are the grittiness and inability to blend well across the face. I mix with moisturizer to thin it out and it still pills up. If putting makeup on overtop, beware of the "peeling" effect this product gives which looks like your skin is peeling from a sunburn where the product doesn't absorb. The smell is quite terrible as well. Takes so getting used to bc I hate thinking my face smells all day. I don't think I'll re-buy after this bottle runs out because of all the negatives.

avis.titre: I'm not sure if I'll purchase again….
avis.texte: I don't love this product, but was closest available to what I have been using for years. Ordinary, PLEASE give us our 30% ascorbic acid in silicone back!!!!

So many of The Ordinary products are incredible. This is no exception. I over used the amount (more than a pea size is too much) the first time. There was a tingle and felt a little odd at first until I rubbed it in a little more. Upon the first use, my skin looked and felt amazing! And I just realized the bumps are HA Spheres! I will have to experiment and see if I still need a sperate serum. Plus, for this level of skincare, the price point is beyond exceptional.

The packaging leaks the product into the lid and sometimes outside of the packaging entirely. I had to mix the vitamin c with a pump of moisturizer so my face wouldnt burn and turn red. Couldnt wear makeup after using this because it would pill.

I've used a ton of high quality vitamin C And this stacks up higher then them all. I'm adding this into my regimen always makes me glow. It's potent so a little goes a long way. Good stuff and affordable!
started having problems with product. has left burn marks under my eyes and it hurts to touch. most likely a chemical burn gritty texture doesnt help and smells horrible.
I've only used it once so far, but it kinds burned a bit when I first put it on. But I'm going to give it a chance, and see if it works.

avis.titre: Product is great, but needs a buffer
avis.texte: Once I learned to use it with a buffer (estee lauder advanced night repair eye cream on my whole face), it worked really well. The grittiness doesn't bother me, but feels like a fine exfoliator. Reminds me of a superhero with some bad social skills.

I tried this product and it made my skin feel really oily. It also had a gritty texture to it! Although it does make you skin look glowing the product on your face does not feel the best! I personally prefer the ordinary 30% vitamin C cream as it feels and has worked for me better but they discontinued it, which is sad!

Love this product. Butn is similar to tea tree oil on skin. Be mindful around eyes and sensitive areas. Tingly burn goes after a few minutes. I use a cooking moisturiser after. Best for night routines or when you are home all day. Leaves skin frelinv fresh, bright and plump.

I tried this because I'd heard good things about other Ordinary products and it was inexpensive. I could get past the sandy/gritty texture if i could stand the smell. I feel like im putting some kind of bathroom cleaner on my face. Returning.

avis.titre: Best Vitamin C serum that works!
avis.texte: I don't understand all of the negative reviews, but I guess everyone's skin is different. In my experience: I've been using this product for a while now and after comparing it to other vitamin C serums, this is my holy grail for waking up with a bright complexion. Usually it takes a number of uses or a few weeks for a face serum to work effectively or to see results; but with this serum, you can literally see a big difference overnight! Although it is really potent and the texture can be a little gritty, you just have to know the proper way to use it. As a person with sensitive skin, I always make sure to mix a small pea sized amount of it with a lot of moisturizer so my skin won't get irritated.

I actually learned something today when it comes to judging what I purchase based off of reviews that have less than four stars. I have used this vitamin C off & on since 2021, and it has always been a consistent benefit for my face in regards to giving me a bright even tone look with smooth texture & plump face appearance. Yes it tingles sometimes, and yes it's a little gritty, but it does absorb well and gives "me" great results that have been consistent. If I were to go by these reviews, I would've never had the opportunity to try it. I think at this reasonable price point, you can do yourself a favor and try it yourself. I only use it in my nightly routine fyi.

avis.titre: Not a good replacement for the other C
avis.texte: I was using The Ordinary 30% but i guess it was discontinued. This version is not smooth and it does not do well under any makeup or powder. It pills badly.
I have never had an issue with The Oedinary products, but this one is a no for me. Gretty texture, very runny and my skin immedietly started burning. I could not get this off my skin fast enough
I gave it a try but the gritty feeling and it makes my skin look way too oily. Plus after a while it sarted smelling terrible. Not worth it and does nothing
this product if awful! it is gritty and runny and not affective. i LOVED the SiliconeVitamin C Suspension 30% in Silicone. it was smooth and felt good on my skin, but it was sadly discontinued.
Decided to try this, but now i regret it. I watched a review that said to mix a small pea size with a moisturizer. I did and woke up to itchy bumps on my face. Will be returning ASAP!

Although vitamin c is great for your skin. This was very gritty and gave me burns on my face. This also made my skin very oily. I tried mixing it with different serums but it didn't work. I also didn't see any improvement and it made me break out.

This products is gritty, burns and tingles on the skin, and smells like boxed hair dye. I'm going to give it another shot mixed with a moisturizer in the future like the directions recommend you do if the tingling/burning is too much, but I think it's a no for me.

I have used this just twice. It is irritating to the skin and drying. I did attempt to combine it with a moisturizer but it is still irritating. I will try again to use it. I need a break from products that irritate.

i didn't try it yet but im soo disappointed i received mine & the box was open & dirty from one side & when i took the product out was not ceiled & so light like if there's nothing in it 😔 i was so excited to try it

avis.titre: grainy texture and left skin extremely greasy
avis.texte: it has a terrible grainy texture that I couldn't get rid of, and it left my face extremely greasy and shiny. I purchased instead of my usual Cerave vitamin c to save money but it just wasn't worth it. Will be going back to ceraves vitamin c

This product is so greasy, I made the mistake of putting it on before bed the first time I used it, and it destroyed my silk pillowcase. I can't imagine how the vitamin c absorbs into the skin given your face is one giant oil slick on the surface. You could honestly fry an egg on your forehead. Maybe this is an ok product if your skin is dryer than the desert, otherwise give it a miss. In the bin!

Have been using other ordinary products for years, been happy with them. But not this one. I was prepared for the texture and tingling of the vitamin C, but the thing I couldn't stand was the smell, just awful :( will be throwing this one away
I wanted to love this product but it just didn't agree with my skin. Product stings/ and leaves blisters.
Love this so much. The combination with hyaluronic acid 2% + B5 is top notch. The glow is different!

avis.titre: Brightens my skin, helps with fine lines
avis.texte: I bought this months ago and love the new texture. It goes on smooth. Sometimes there's light stinging but that goes away after a few minutes if I feel it at all. I like that it brightens my skin and smooths the texture. My fine lines aren't noticeable when I apply this. Do a patch test first and see if it works for you. I mix it in with a cerave face lotion after toner, which works perfectly for me. My skin is perfectly hydrated. Don't forget sunscreen on top when you go outside if you apply in the AM.
Vitamin C -very careful when squeezing. It does come out fast. You need to squeeze slowly. It was a bit grainy which is I was shocked but as you massage your face it melts in your skin.

The first time I bought this product in 2023, it felt like sandpaper and tingled slightly when applied. And it worked. Just bought a new tube, and there is no sandpaper texture, and it doesn't tingle at all. Just feels like a generic drug store lotion now. Did you change the formulation?

avis.titre: Great product so worth it love it…but
avis.texte: I am giving this one star so only complain about the packaging ugh it's so bad. This is a runny product and it's very hard to regulate how much you get out. You will waist because it runs out. I would love them to put this in a dropper bottle or a bottle or tube with a pump on it. Please!!!! Change this packaging! This product does sting but it says it will it is just magic for mature skin. Love it.

avis.titre: Use it correctly and it will bless you
avis.texte: I mix this with my moisturizer in the morning and have never had a problem. After a long quest through the Vitamin C serums offered by various brands, I found myself repeatedly returning to The Ordinary's Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%. From the very first application, the effects were not just noticeable but remarkable. My skin felt glowy and visibly brighter, an elusive goal that many other products promised but could never quite deliver. However, it's not without its flaws. The texture is quite heavy, which might not be suitable for all skin types. The gritty feel upon application can also be off-putting. Despite these issues, the formula's effectiveness in enhancing skin radiance is undeniable. I initially decided not to repurchase after finishing my first tube, driven away by the textural issues. But the lackluster performance of other products quickly brought me back. Now on my fourth tube. If you can get past the gritty texture and the heavier feel, The Ordinary's Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2% might just be the game-changer your skincare routine needs. It's a potent product that delivers serious results, making it a worthy investment for those chasing a bright, glowing complexion.

avis.titre: It works, just needs a bit of help
avis.texte: Originally, I bought this product because I thought that vitamin C would really help me with my acne scars. It was a good price super affordable. The first time I used it I would either have to apply it by itself or not at all. You can't pile on like the other serums or liquids that you put on your face. It does pill very quickly. in addition to that if you're just putting this alone, it's gonna burn. That being said, I did buy it so I was determined for it to work. Things started to change when I began mixing it with a serum like hyaluronic acid or snail mucin, and I would mix it in small amounts from that point on it has been incorporated in my nightly routine to the point where I only need this, snail, Mussen, and glycolic acid. What changed for me when I started using this product is that I stopped having my monthly break outs and was able to stop using as many prodcufs. I definitely would recommend this product to someone who is currently looking for a skin regimen that's working for them. Because after searching for years, this was finally the thing that healed my skin.
